description: This Java class acts as a command handler for prematurely closing recurring deposit accounts within the Apache Fineract project. It handles the specific command type 'PREMATURECLOSE' for entities of type 'RECURRINGDEPOSITACCOUNT' and delegates the actual operation to the depositAccountWritePlatformService.

classes.name: PrematureCloseRecurringDepositAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands for premature closure of recurring deposit accounts, specified by the command type 'PREMATURECLOSE'. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and delegates processing to 'DepositAccountWritePlatformService'.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command to prematurely close a recurring deposit account by invoking the corresponding method in the depositAccountWritePlatformService.
